holderPosition.legalForm: Registered ordinary share of Bullish, a Cayman Islands company listed on the NYSE, held in token form on Solana; legal title rests in the register of members, administered by Equiniti Trust Company, LLC as transfer agent
holderPosition.says: The holder owns the Bullish ordinary share itself, with the standing of any registered shareholder (one vote per share; no dividend has ever been paid), and no SPV, custodian or nominee in between. Any inconsistency between the chain and the register of members is resolved by the register; holding needs KYC with Equiniti and a whitelisted wallet, and a token lost with its key may not be replaced.

outside.says: Withdraw and return tokens through Equiniti's Shareholder Central; returning gives a book-entry position, not cash. No burn address, fee or turnaround is published.

The risk factors say Bullish may be required to redeem, cancel or impose restrictions on tokenized shares, possibly through administrative controls in the token code; tokens lost with a key 'may be permanently lost', with no replacement guaranteed. The Bullish Exchange rulebooks describe issuer freeze, seizure and burn powers over tokenized assets.

Cayman Islands companies law governs the share and the register of members, which confers legal title, with rectification by the Grand Court; US securities law governs the listing and the transfer agents; Gibraltar law governs the exchange.

Bullish Exchange trades the token 24/7 against a USD stablecoin; AMM and DEX trading are not enabled; NYSE prices the book-entry share, and the basis between them is bounded by no published mechanism.

verdict.summary: An origin of kind share plus Equiniti's register entries says what the holder has, and the issuer says in plain words that the register of members prevails. That sentence still needs the authoritative-record proposal, the token is Token-2022, and Equiniti, whose register decides everything, publishes nothing itself. There are no token terms to commit to, and v3 cannot show that issuer, venue and soon the transfer agent are one group.
